description: Opening the synced replica as a plain local file (--db .todo-db/replica.db) bypasses the hosted verify --run gate and executes shared-DB-authored commands ungated; hosted errors at execute/commit time bypass both redaction and auth classification (only connect/sync are wrapped). Gate on replica provenance (e.g. detect replica sidecar files) and wrap execute/commit.

work_units.evidence: Replica provenance gate and execute/commit error wrapping tested
work_units.summary: Replica-provenance gate + execute/commit error wrapping + tests
